benefici.titolo: Films that hold up in every season

fasi.d: In this first stage we dive into your needs and goals. We analyse the type of project and work closely with you to understand exactly what you want to achieve from your vehicle's decoration.

We develop a free, tailored quote, choosing the technologies and materials best suited to the job, to ensure every detail lives up to expectations. We create designs that reflect your brand, catch the eye and enhance your image.

Once the project is approved we move to the operational phase: with our cutting-edge equipment we handle production and application at our premises or yours, depending on your needs and feasibility. Everything is carried out with precision and within the agreed timeframe.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to wrap a vehicle in Biasca?
faq.risposta: The price depends on the size of the vehicle, the type of work (partial graphics or full wrap) and the materials chosen. For a tradesperson's van or a company car, we prepare a free, tailored quote within 24/48h.

faq.domanda: Do you work across all of Biasca and the nearby towns?
faq.risposta: Yes. We look after businesses throughout Biasca, from the centre to the industrial area, the neighbourhoods and the towns of the Riviera, as well as vehicles heading up towards Blenio and Leventina. From small trade firms to companies with several vehicles.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to wrap a van?
faq.risposta: Usually 1 to 6 working days, depending on the complexity of the graphics and the surface to cover. We agree the timing together so we don't keep your work vehicle off the road any longer than necessary.

faq.domanda: Do I bring the vehicle to you, or do you come to Biasca?
faq.risposta: We work out the most convenient option together: application can take place at our premises or, depending on feasibility and the type of work, directly in your area, wherever your business is based. We organise things to keep your travel to a minimum.

faq.domanda: Can I have just the doors or part of the van decorated?
faq.risposta: Absolutely. We offer both partial graphics, ideal for a logo and contact details on the sides, and a full vehicle wrap, depending on the visual impact and budget you're after.

faq.domanda: What's the difference between partial graphics and a full car wrap?
faq.risposta: Partial graphics apply lettering and designs to certain surfaces, such as the doors and rear. A full car wrap covers the entire bodywork, letting you even change the vehicle's colour and achieve maximum advertising impact.

faq.domanda: Do the films damage the bodywork when they're removed?
faq.risposta: No. We use quality removable films that, applied and removed properly, don't damage the original paint and can even protect it from everyday minor scratches.

faq.domanda: Can I see a preview before printing?
faq.risposta: Yes. Before producing the graphics we send you a draft of the design on the vehicle, so you can review and confirm it. The draft is usually available after a deposit has been paid.
